A playful and captivating melody from the golden era of Bollywood! Sharma Na Yoon Ghabra Na Yoon from Joshila (1973) features Dev Anand and Bindu in a memorable musical moment. Sung by the legendary Asha Bhosle and composed by the musical genius R. D. Burman, this delightful number showcases the vibrant sound and charm of 70s Hindi film music. E
